title: Integrated care boards, April 2026 (England, generalised, clipped)
description: NHS integrated care boards as published for April 2026, the geography NHS England reports referral to treatment waiting times against.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "Integrated_Care_Boards_April_2026_Boundaries_EN_BGC" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Integrated_Care_Boards_April_2026_Boundaries_EN_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 36 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
